:::{#def-moment}
#### Raw moment

The **$k$-th raw moment** of a [random variable](random-variables.qmd#def-random-variable) $X$, for a positive integer $k$ with $\E{\abs{X}^k} < \infty$,
is the [expectation](expectation.qmd#def-expectation) of $X^k$:

$$\E{X^k}$$

:::

{{< slidebreak >}}

:::{#def-central-moment}
#### Central moment

The **$k$-th central moment** of a [random variable](random-variables.qmd#def-random-variable) $X$, for a positive integer $k$ with $\E{\abs{X}^k} < \infty$,
is the [expectation](expectation.qmd#def-expectation) of the $k$-th power of the [deviation from the mean](#def-deviation-pop-mean):

$$\E{[\devn(X)]^k}$$

:::

{{< slidebreak >}}

:::{#thm-moments-low-order}
#### The first raw moment and the second central moment

If $\E{X^2} < \infty$, then:

$$
\ba
\E{X} &= \text{the first raw moment of } X \\
\Var{X} &= \text{the second central moment of } X
\ea
$$

:::

::: proof

The first raw moment is $\E{X^1} = \E{X}$ by @def-moment.
The second central moment is $\E{[\devn(X)]^2}$ by @def-central-moment,
which is $\Var{X}$ by @def-variance.

:::
